svg.title: One request: 2,000 prompt tokens in, 500 tokens out
svg.desc: A timeline for one request drawn to scale. Prefill, all 2,000 prompt tokens at once, is a thin block of half a second that ends at the first token. Decode follows as 499 thin ticks of 20 ms each, filling the rest of the roughly 10.5 seconds. Below: total time equals TTFT plus TPOT times the number of output tokens.
svg.text: One request: 2,000 prompt tokens in, 500 tokens out

g.text: Prefill: all 2,000 prompt tokens at once
ends with the first output token (TTFT = 0.5 s)
Decode: the other 499 tokens, one per step, 20 ms each (TPOT)
zoomed in: each step waits for the one before it
total time = TTFT + TPOT × output tokens
0.5 s + 499 × 0.02 s = 10.48 s. The answer, not the prompt, is where the time goes.

svg.text: Drawn to scale with the article's made-up but realistic numbers: TTFT 0.5 s, TPOT 20 ms. Formula from Databricks (2023).
